about: Adaptive simulated students (grades 8-11) for the force and speeding up mission (TUNE-3). Same card format and how_to_use rules as tests/fixtures/students/a_tri.json. Every line is original; no real student text. Four cards: annoyed_obvious, deep_why_stuck, quick_user, misuser.

personas.who: Says everything in one text, including the stuff everyone knows, and hates being asked it again.
personas.style: lowercase, terse, a little smug, no apostrophes
personas.first_text: F equals m times a. a full cart is harder to get going than an empty one so more mass means less speed-up. 10 N on a 2 kg cart is a = 10 divided by 2 = 5 m/s2

asks_why: bc a full cart is harder to get going than an empty one
asks_check_number: the full one is harder to get going. 10 / 2 = 5
pip_wrong_prediction: no the heavy one speeds up less
no. divide the push by the mass
nudge_hint: ohh like pushing a car vs a skateboard
after_quiz_miss: no wait. the empty cart takes off and the full one barely moves, same push
so more mass means less acceleration
default: same push on a heavy thing barely moves it. think of pushing a car vs a skateboard

expect.asks_obvious: any ask about a given or use idea the first text already covered (or a bare why after a reason) is an annoying move
expect.watch_for: The first text covers the whole lesson. Best Pip says ready or asks one new case. Any re-ask or 'why' on a use/given idea costs the session.
